intro: In the Charred Vale, chimaera matriarchs bear horns that Stormwind and Thunder Bluff armorers seek. These hardened growths go into specialized armor for warriors.

p: Chimaera matriarchs prowl the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains. Their horns grow unusually hard through ash, flame, and survival. Lesser fledgling chimaeras yield brittle, blackened horns, but a matriarch's horn has strength like treated metal. Furen Longbeard in Stormwind and Orm Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff both seek one as a test of martial valor and a key ingredient for exceptional mail armor.
